name: copiale_evidence
description: Five Copiale evidence-packet Track-B pages (transcription2plaintext) solved as one shared-key page group. These are the five copiale_evidence single-page rows from frontier/copiale_evidence_packet.jsonl; the multipage route combines them into one ciphertext, runs the homophonic route once, projects the shared key back per page, and (with the word_repair refinement) exercises cross-page repair adjudication. Ground truth is used for post-hoc per-page scoring only.
